nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic, increased by SlotTicket.mint and used by the transfer logic.
Mapping address => token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and mint, and by the direct writes inside Slot.mint flow.
Nested allowance mapping owner => spender => amount, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Privileged owner address set in the Ownable constructor and read by the onlyOwner modifier guarding administrative functions.
Boolean pause flag read by whenNotPaused / whenPaused modifiers and flipped by pause and unpause.
SlotTicket instance deployed in the Slot constructor, used for minting receipts and for token.destroy().
Mapping game => index => participant address; the payout destination list for prize and refund transfers.
Fixed array of eight ether prize amounts iterated by awardPrizes.
Accumulated jackpot balance, seeded in the constructor, drained by distributeJackpot and refilled by distributeRemaining.
Current game counter used as the first key into participants and advanced by increaseGame.
Block number at which the current game started; used by the inactivity refund check.
One-way flag that permanently disables destroy().
House wallet address receiving 249 finney at the end of each completed game.
Global ticket counter driving the participant index and the completion of a game of SIZE participants.
Constant public ticket price of 100 finney used in price math and refunds.
Caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership assignment, ticket purchase and ether refunds.
ERC20 transfer that moves balances between msg.sender and _to using SafeMath.
Allowance-based transfer that reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] and moves balances.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with a zero-first race condition guard.
onlyOwner function reassigning ownership of the contract.
onlyOwner function setting paused = true.
onlyOwner function setting paused = false.
onlyOwner mint that increases totalSupply and credits balances[_to]; called by buyTicketsFor.
onlyOwner function that selfdestructs the ticket contract.
Payable constructor that deploys SlotTicket, sets wallet, jackpotAmount, counter, gameStarted and undestroyable.
Payable fallback that forwards to buyTicketsFor(msg.sender), buying tickets for the caller.
Payable entry point computing ticket count, minting tokens, recording participants and refunding change.
Private loop writing participants and triggering awardPrizes, distributeRemaining and increaseGame when a game fills.
Private pseudo-random generator using previous blockhashes modulo _size.
Private function computing winners and transferring each entry of the prizes array to participant addresses.
Private function transferring jackpotAmount to a winning participant and zeroing the jackpot.
Private function adding 250 finney to the jackpot, paying the wallet 249 finney and refunding 1 finney to msg.sender.
Private function incrementing gameNumber and resetting gameStarted.
Public refund routine paying PRICE to each recorded participant after INACTIVITY blocks and reducing the counter.
onlyOwner function that destroys the token contract and selfdestructs when not marked undestroyable.
onlyOwner function replacing the house wallet address.
onlyOwner one-way switch setting undestroyable = true.
Checked addition used throughout Slot and token bookkeeping.
Checked subtraction used for balance, allowance and block-number math.
Checked multiplication helper in the SafeMath library.
Division helper in the SafeMath library, used for ticket count computation.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, granting privileged role to the deploying caller.
External ether transfer of the ticket change back to msg.sender after minting and participant recording.
External ether transfer to an attacker-influenceable participant address inside the prize loop.
External ether transfer of the whole jackpot to an attacker-influenceable winner address.
External ether transfer to the house wallet address inside the game-completion flow.
External ether transfer of the gas refund to msg.sender executed in the middle of the ticket loop.
External ether transfer of PRICE to every recorded participant before the counter is reduced.
Selfdestruct paying the contract balance to the owner from Slot.destroy.
Selfdestruct of the SlotTicket contract invoked through token.destroy().
Weak pseudo-randomness derived from block.blockhash of previous blocks and truncated with a modulo.
Raw unchecked counter decrement (counter -= counter % SIZE) performed without SafeMath.
External call into the SlotTicket token contract (mint) made before the caller is refunded and before the game state settles.
Ticket recipient parameter of buyTicketsFor, forwarded to token.mint and addParticipant.
Remainder msg.value % PRICE computed in buyTicketsFor and refunded to msg.sender.
Number of tickets derived from msg.value in buyTicketsFor and passed to mint and addParticipant.
Participant address parameter of addParticipant stored into the participants mapping.
Ticket count parameter bounding the addParticipant loop.
Loop index of addParticipant used to write participants entries.
Winner index local in awardPrizes produced by rand and incremented for each prize.
Boolean local in awardPrizes deciding whether distributeJackpot executes.
Return value of rand computed from the blockhash modulo _size.
Modulus parameter of rand controlling the randomness range.
Winning participant index parameter of distributeJackpot used to select the jackpot payee.
New house wallet address parameter of changeWallet.
Initial house wallet parameter of the Slot constructor.
Cached allowance local in transferFrom used for the allowance subtraction.
Recipient parameter of BasicToken.transfer.
Amount parameter of BasicToken.transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the balance owner on the sender side of BasicToken.transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
approve stores allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller identity.
The Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the privileged role to the caller.
Computed change is transferred back to msg.sender.
The 1 finney gas repayment is sent to msg.sender.
buyTicketsFor is public and the fallback feeds msg.sender into it as beneficiary.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity is callable by anyone and its transfers go to recorded participants.
The Slot constructor deploys a new SlotTicket instance.
The constructor sets the house wallet address.
The constructor seeds jackpotAmount with msg.value.
The constructor initializes counter to zero.
The constructor sets gameStarted = block.number.
The constructor sets undestroyable to false.
The payable fallback buys tickets for msg.sender by calling buyTicketsFor.
buyTicketsFor records the buyer by calling addParticipant.
buyTicketsFor mints ticket tokens by calling token.mint.
buyTicketsFor performs an external call into the SlotTicket token contract via mint.
addParticipant writes participants[gameNumber][counter%SIZE] for each ticket.
addParticipant increments the global counter of recorded tickets.
addParticipant calls awardPrizes when the counter reaches a multiple of SIZE.
addParticipant calls distributeRemaining after the prizes have been awarded.
addParticipant calls increaseGame at the end of a completed game.
rand derives its output from previous block hashes, i.e. the weak randomness operation.
awardPrizes calls rand to choose the winner index and the jackpot condition.
awardPrizes reads participants entries to determine the payout recipients.
awardPrizes iterates the fixed prizes array to determine the payout amounts.
awardPrizes performs an external transfer to an attacker-controllable participant address inside its loop.
awardPrizes calls distributeJackpot when the jackpot condition is satisfied.
distributeJackpot reads the winning participant address from participants.
distributeJackpot zeroes jackpotAmount after sending the transfer.
distributeJackpot sends ether to an attacker-controllable winner before completing its state updates.
distributeRemaining adds 250 finney to the jackpot using SafeMath.
distributeRemaining pays the stored house wallet address.
distributeRemaining performs an external transfer to the wallet address.
distributeRemaining refunds 1 finney to msg.sender with an external call in the middle of the ticket loop.
increaseGame increments gameNumber, shifting the participants key space.
increaseGame resets gameStarted to the current block number.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity reads participants entries to refund each recorded ticket holder.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity reduces the global counter by counter % SIZE.
The refund loop sends ether to every recorded participant before the counter is decremented.
The counter is decremented with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.sub.
refundGameAfterLongInactivity advances the game by calling increaseGame.
Slot.destroy calls selfdestruct(owner).
Slot.destroy calls token.destroy(), destroying the ticket contract.
The selfdestruct in destroy pays the remaining balance to owner.
SlotTicket.destroy calls selfdestruct.
changeWallet overwrites the house wallet state variable.
makeUndestroyable sets undestroyable to true.
SlotTicket.mint increases totalSupply with SafeMath.add.
SlotTicket.mint credits balances[_to] with the minted amount.
unpause sets paused to false.
pause sets paused to true.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom moves balances between _from and _to.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance in allowed.
transfer adjusts balances for msg.sender and _to.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier checks owner before transferOwnership executes.
The onlyOwner modifier checks owner before destroy executes.
The onlyOwner modifier checks owner before changeWallet executes.
The onlyOwner modifier checks owner before makeUndestroyable executes.
The external prize transfer to a participant contract can reenter addParticipant/buyTicketsFor while the ticket loop is still running.
The 1 finney refund to msg.sender can reenter buyTicketsFor during the award/distribution flow.
The jackpot transfer to the winner can reenter awardPrizes before the loop finishes.
The refund transfer can reenter refundGameAfterLongInactivity before the counter decrement completes.
BasicToken.transfer uses SafeMath.sub and add for balance arithmetic.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the cached allowance.
mint uses SafeMath.add for the supply and balance updates.
The inactivity check relies on SafeMath.sub of gameStarted from block.number.
buyTicketsFor uses SafeMath.div for the ticket count computation.

normalization_plan.reason: Ticket recipient parameter consumed directly by the buyTicketsFor entry point.
Change local is the exact value forwarded to the external refund transfer.
Ticket count local is derived from msg.value and is passed into the external mint call.
Participant parameter is written into the participants mapping by addParticipant.
Ticket count parameter bounds the addParticipant loop.
Loop index of addParticipant only exists to drive the participant writes.
Winner index local is produced by rand and iterated inside awardPrizes.
Jackpot flag local only controls the branch to distributeJackpot inside awardPrizes.
Returned random value is exactly the blockhash-derived weak randomness output.
Modulus parameter only shapes the rand output range.
Winning index parameter selects the jackpot payee inside distributeJackpot.
New wallet parameter is assigned to the wallet state variable.
Initial wallet parameter is stored by the Slot constructor.
Cached allowance local exists only for the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
Recipient parameter of the basic transfer entry point.
Amount parameter of the basic transfer entry point.
